text: 2026-09-30 on S3: ~3-4 s lag to reach full brightness is the Philips BA11 bulb's driver, not firmware. Raw 10->100 switched fire delay 7499us->150us immediately (confirmed on page) while the bulb still took ~4 s to brighten. Also: raw 10 lights (very dim) on S3, so trim low can likely go ~10-12 (C6-era floor of 20 was distorted by jitter). Next: compare a different dimmable bulb's 10->100 response if the lag matters.
author: edinel
